title: Three Adults Standing Outdoors, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photograph 1948
description: A black and white snapshot from July 6, 1948, depicting three adults standing along a suburban sidewalk. The man on the right wears a formal dark suit with a vest, while the woman in the center wears a wide-brimmed hat, light coat, and dark skirt. The man on the left wears casual short-sleeved button-up shirt and high-waisted trousers. Vintage automobiles and residential homes are visible in the background.
